L1-01.subject: Inquiry regarding order A1051
L1-01.body: Dear Customer Service, I am writing to check on the status of my order A1051. Could you please let me know where it is? Best regards, Tom.

L1-02.subject: Delivery inquiry for Ireland
L1-02.body: Hi there, I was wondering if you could let me know if you ship your homeware products over to Ireland? If so, could you please tell me how much the delivery charge would be? Many thanks.

L1-03.subject: Inquiry regarding return policy
L1-03.body: Hello there, I am just writing to ask about your return window. If I decide that an item isn't quite right for me, how much time do I have to initiate a return? Thanks for your help.

L1-04.subject: Status inquiry regarding order A1033
L1-04.body: Hi there, I am just checking in to see if my order A1033 has arrived at its destination yet. Could you please let me know the status of this delivery? Thanks.

L1-05.subject: Inquiry regarding order A1071
L1-05.body: Hello, I am writing to check in on the progress of order A1071. Could you please provide me with an update on its current status? Thank you.

L1-06.subject: Question regarding accepted payment methods
L1-06.body: Hello there, I was just browsing your store and was wondering if you happen to accept PayPal as a payment option? Thanks for your help.

L2-01.subject: Regarding my return for order A1042
L2-01.body: Hello there, I am writing to let you know that I would like to return the linen tea towel included in my order A1042. I have decided that I do not actually need this item. Thank you, Priya.

L2-02.subject: Issue with order A1071
L2-02.body: Hi there, I’m writing to let you know that my delivery for order A1071 just arrived, but unfortunately, the oak frame is damaged with a crack in the glass. Could you please process a refund for this item? Thanks.

L2-03.subject: Issue with Order A1090
L2-03.body: Hi there, I’m writing because I unfortunately opened my package for order A1090 today to find that the glass carafe was completely shattered. Would it be possible for you to send out a replacement for this item? Thanks, best regards.

L2-04.subject: Regarding order A1033
L2-04.body: Hi there, I am writing to see if I could please get a refund for the two speckled mugs I bought in order A1033. They haven't been used at all, so they are in perfect condition. Let me know how to proceed. Thanks, Best regards.

L2-05.subject: Regarding order A1052 - Return request
L2-05.body: Hi there, I hope you're having a good day. I'm writing to see if I could please send back the wool throw blanket that was part of order A1052. Unfortunately, the color isn't quite what I was anticipating. Many thanks, and I look forward to hearing from you.

L2-06.subject: Issue with order A1063
L2-06.body: Hi there, I’m writing because I just opened my package for order A1063 and unfortunately the glass bud vase is chipped. I’d really appreciate it if you could issue a refund for this item. Thanks, a customer.

L3-01.subject: Regarding order A0990 - item return
L3-01.body: Hi there, I am writing to you because I would like to send back the velvet cushion that I purchased in order A0990. I have decided that I am not a fan of the colour after all. Thank you.

L3-02.subject: Return request for order A1070
L3-02.body: Hi there, I hope you're having a good week. I am writing because I've decided that I no longer need the cotton throw from order A1070. Would it be possible to return this item to you and get a refund? Thanks so much for your help. Best regards.

L3-03.subject: Regarding my recent order A1063
L3-03.body: Hi there, I'm writing to you today because the jute rug I received as part of order A1063 just doesn't look right in my room, unfortunately. I would like to go ahead and return this item for a full refund. Please let me know how I should proceed. Best regards.

L3-04.subject: Issue with order A1091 - Damaged item
L3-04.body: Hi there, I am writing to let you know that my ceramic serving bowl from order A1091 arrived broken. Could you please send me a replacement for this? Thanks!

L3-05.subject: Issue with delivery for order A1080
L3-05.body: Hi there, I am writing because my tracking information claims that order A1080 was delivered, but unfortunately, I haven't received it yet. I have checked my porch and spoken with my neighbours, but it is nowhere to be found. Could you please help me locate it? Thanks.

L3-06.subject: Issue with order - broken items
L3-06.body: Hi there, I recently received my order and was quite disappointed to find that two of the mugs in the set were smashed upon arrival. Since they are broken, I would appreciate a full refund for the set. Thanks.

L3-07.subject: Missing delivery update for order A1081
L3-07.body: Hello there, I am writing to you because my tracking information for order A1081 has been stagnant for a full two weeks now. Since it does not seem to be moving, I would appreciate it if you could kindly send out a replacement for me. Thank you.

L3-08.subject: Return for A1042
L3-08.body: Dear Customer Support Team, I hope you are having a good day. My name is Priya Shah and I am reaching out regarding order A1042. I would like to request a refund for the tea towel included in this order. Please note that I am sending this message from my work email address. Many thanks, Priya Shah.

L4-01.subject: Status inquiry regarding order A1051
L4-01.body: To whom it may concern, I am writing to kindly request an update on the current shipping status of order A1051. I look forward to hearing from you soon. Best regards.

L4-02.subject: Regarding order #a-1042
L4-02.body: Hi there, I hope you're having a good week. I'm writing because I'd like to get a refund for the linen tea towel included in order #a-1042. I've realized I don't actually have a use for it anymore, so if you could process that return for me, I'd really appreciate it. Thanks so much, best regards.

L4-03.subject: Return request for order A1033
L4-03.body: Hi there, I hope you're having a good week. I am writing to see if I could please get a refund for the two speckled mugs I purchased in order A1033. They haven't been used at all and are still in their original condition. Thanks for your help with this, best regards.

L4-04.subject: Issue with delivery: A1090
L4-04.body: Hi there, I'm just getting in touch because I received my order A1090 today, but unfortunately the carafe inside arrived shattered. Could you please send out a replacement for me? Thanks!

L4-05.subject: Issue with order A1071 - Damaged item
L4-05.body: Hi there, I recently received my order A1071 and unfortunately, the glass on the frame arrived completely cracked. I would like to request a refund for this item, please. Thank you.

L4-06.subject: Issue with Order A1063
L4-06.body: Hi there, I’m writing because I’ve just opened my package for order A1063 and unfortunately the bud vase is chipped. Would it be possible to get a refund for this item? Thanks, best regards.

L5-01.subject: Urgent: Update shipping details for order A1088
L5-01.body: Hi there, I hope you're having a good day. I'm just writing to let you know that I've recently moved house, so could you please update the delivery address for my order A1088? I need the package sent to 14 Elm Road, Leeds LS6 2AB instead. Thanks so much for your help with this. Best, a loyal customer.

L5-02.subject: Urgent: Order cancellation request for A1077
L5-02.body: Hi there, I am writing to you because I accidentally placed order A1077 and I would like to request that you cancel it immediately. Thank you for your help with this.

L5-03.subject: Inquiry regarding my recent orders
L5-03.body: Hello, I am writing to check on the status of my order A1051, as it hasn't arrived yet. Additionally, I would like to request a refund for the wool blanket that I received in order A1052. Please let me know the process for sending this back. Thank you.

L5-04.subject: Issue with duplicate charge for order A1095
L5-04.body: Hi there, I am reaching out because I noticed that I have been billed twice for order A1095. Could you please look into this and get it straightened out for me? Thanks.

L5-05.subject: Delaying shipment for A1077
L5-05.body: Hi there, I've placed order A1077 with you, but I'm going to be out of town until the 10th of November. Would it be possible to keep hold of this for me and arrange for it to be dispatched once I'm back after that date? Thanks for your help. Best, a customer.

L5-06.subject: Issues with recent order - A1090 and A1091
L5-06.body: Hi there, I’m writing because I’ve just opened my delivery and unfortunately some things are damaged. The carafe from order A1090 arrived completely smashed, so I would really prefer a refund for that one instead of a replacement. Also, the serving bowl from A1091 is cracked; I'd like to have that one replaced if possible. Thanks for your help. Best regards.
